svg.title: Terraform rescue lab: diagnosis, fixes, state migration and plan gate
svg.desc: Read-only CI scans of the inherited Terraform (Checkov 47, tflint 12) become a report with 10 ranked findings. Three fix pull requests rebuild after/ as one tested module with thin roots. The laptop state moves to an encrypted, versioned S3 bucket with a lockfile. A read-only OIDC plan role plans each PR, the plan gate confirms 0 to destroy, and a client engineer applies the reviewed plan; a second plan shows no changes.

g.text: Harbor Goods AWS account · one Region
Plan: 1 to import, 12 to add, 7 to change, 0 to destroy
The rescue, from diagnosis to repair
Three fix PRs: one tested module, thin roots
Local state moves to S3, locked and encrypted
Plan gate: 0 to destroy, then a reviewed apply
